original_style_1.name: Lithic Dreams
original_style_1.concept: Memory is geological. Forms crystallize from compressed time. Thought has weight and erosion.
original_style_1.thesis: All visual elements suggest geological processes: stratification, crystallization, erosion, compression.
original_style_1.coherence: All share slate blue/ochre/white palette, crystalline/strata shapes, geological texture, theatrical light
